title: Orange Bank
full_description: Orange Bank is renewing itself for ever more innovation, we detail everything here:With the Orange Bank Premium Card: We offer ourselves the best of 100% mobile banking- We pay as we want. We have the choice of payment methods: Premium Mastercard, Google Pay and contactless payment, transfer by SMS.- We are very well insured. Travel insurance and means of payment, and even warranty extension included for our purchases.- We manage our budget quietly. Deferred or immediate, you choose the debit you want and with the instant balance, you always know where you are.- We avoid the costs. Free payments and withdrawals everywhere, express and free card return, anywhere in the world. And no account maintenance fees as soon as you use your means of payment once.- We take advantage of Cashback at Orange with 5% reimbursed on invoices and purchases.- You are master of privileges thanks to your Mastercard, you benefit from the Mastercard® Priceless ™ Cities and Mastercard® Travel Rewards programs.- We are well protected for our purchases. Ensures all the hassles related to our purchases: order, delivery, dispute, and even warranty extension.In short, we kept the best and we even added more:- Copy / paste the card number directly from the app: when you don't have your card with you, you still have your card with you: with the new function, online purchases are even easier.- Enhanced security. Strong authentication, choice and modification of the secret code of your Mastercard card at any time- A card that shines at night, their ultra elegant design lights up and with that, we shine brightly: WAHOU effect guaranteed!The Premium Pack has something for the whole family.see conditions on orangebank.fr- For the parentAll the benefits of the Premium card and the ability to easily manage the accounts used by your children from your App: view the balances, be notified of their purchases if you wish, adjust the limits, pay them money ... Everything while remaining calm: no overdraft authorized on their accounts and the debit is immediate thanks to the Plus card.- For each of your childrenFrom 10 years old, a card and an App all their own to learn how to manage their budget: several possible payment methods (cards, Google Pay, SMS transfer), notifications for each purchase if you wish, the piggy bank to put aside and have fun by buying what they want themselves.Exclusive advantages (free payments and withdrawals abroad, purchase protection insurance, Orange cashback).The Standard card, you pay with it, you don't pay it.- Free as soon as you carry out one operation per month (card payment, Google Pay, withdrawal)- We pay as we want, wherever we want: contactless card, Google Pay, online payment, transfer by SMS or IBAN,- We pay where we want, free payments and withdrawals in the euro zone.- We are well covered, repatriation assistance up to € 11,000, means of payment insured in the event of loss or theft.- Reinforced security: Temporary blocking of the card if necessary, strong authentication, choice and modification of the card's secret code at any time from the App. Card payment settings: internet, contactless, abroad. Alerts and notifications on all your operations- Exclusive advantages: access to the Mastercard® Priceless ™ Cities privilege program.
